premises.text: Security teams cannot easily answer company-wide questions about where sensitive files and PII live and who accesses them
premises.evidence_span: a security team has no easy way to answer any of the questions I ask, especially company-wide

premises.text: Traditional DLP forces users to choose between security and productivity and is slow and burdensome to deploy
premises.evidence_span: Existing cyber solutions make humans responsible for security actions, when in reality, security actions often get in the way of getting a job done

premises.text: Identity-tied per-file encryption secures unused files while leaving only actively used files exposed
premises.evidence_span: If you have 1,000 files on your computer and you're only using one, then you expose that one while 999 files are secured by Phalanx

premises.text: The overlay works inside users' existing document workflows so everyday double-click access remains familiar
premises.evidence_span: we overlay that into the existing environments that they're already in

premises.text: Identity-based automation deploys in less than a day with zero weekly maintenance versus months of rules-based DLP setup
premises.evidence_span: we're deployable in less than a day and requires zero weekly maintenance

premises.text: A digital map and API make file access who/what/where/how visible and actionable across workspaces
premises.evidence_span: Phalanx provides a digital map of every file across every existing workspace

premises.text: Go-to-market reaches mid/large enterprise via per-user sales and SMBs via channel partners
premises.evidence_span: dual-pronged go-to-market strategy where we focus on mid- to large-scale enterprise by doing per-user requirements
